about: One-line descriptions of EXISTING public functions of the shared tools files that have no docstring (card chat-T8, user 2026-10-09). Key '<module>.<function>' (module = file name without .py; a method is 'Class.method'). Writing a docstring into an existing function would shift every file:line citation below it, so its description lives here; a NEW function carries a docstring instead (docs/script-writing.md rule 9). tools/gen_capabilities.py shows a docstring first, else this entry, else '(undocumented)'; a key whose function is gone is a WARN in doc_lint L12. Each entry says what the function does and what it returns, verified by reading its code.

items.stage_prerun.sha256: SHA-256 hex digest of a file; a .py/.ps1 is hashed WITHOUT its scope header block (scope_header.canonical_bytes) so records written before the header migration still match. Returns the hex string.
items.stagesim.parse_addr: Terminal address -> {'uid': head, 'term': terminal}: a dict is copied, a '<uid>.<terminal>' / 'new:<kind><n>.<terminal>' string is split at its first '.'; anything else raises SimError.
items.stagexec.edges: Groups terminal rows by wire_uid; returns (E, dang): E = set of (source term_uid, sink term_uid) pairs of every wire, dang = term_uids on a wire that has no source or no sink.
